boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on practical Charles Village, Remington, Hampden, and nearby corridors around the Homewood campus.

cards.title: Free galleries on Art Museum Drive
cards.subtitle: Art Museum Drive, beside the Homewood campus
cards.notes: Reserve a free general-admission ticket, then use the museum map to choose galleries or the Sculpture Gardens that fit your available time.
cards.short_summary: A nearby art museum with free general admission by reservation.
cards.evidence_claim: The BMA is at 10 Art Museum Drive near North Charles and 31st Streets; general admission is free with a reservation.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit — Baltimore Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: General admission requires a free reservation; special exhibitions require separate tickets.

cards.title: A community library stop on St. Paul
cards.subtitle: St. Paul Street corridor, Charles Village
cards.notes: Check the library’s open hours before walking over; browse books, use free Wi‑Fi, or spend time in the public garden during library hours.
cards.short_summary: An independent neighborhood library with public-facing reading and garden space.
cards.evidence_claim: Village Learning Place is at 2521 St. Paul Street, offers books and research computers, and has free Wi‑Fi; its garden is open to the public during library hours.
cards.source_title: Use The Library — Village Learning Place
cards.access_notes: Library hours listed as Monday–Thursday and Saturday, 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; confirm before visiting.

cards.title: Free books on Vineyard Lane
cards.subtitle: Vineyard Lane, off East 30th Street
cards.notes: Consult the organization’s monthly announcement before going, then bring a bag and choose books during its public giveaway opening.
cards.short_summary: A monthly public book giveaway where every book is free.
cards.evidence_claim: The Book Thing puts unwanted books into readers’ hands for free, and all books taken are free; it opens to the public one day per month.
cards.source_title: Contact — The Book Thing of Baltimore
cards.access_notes: Open one day per month; check the News section for the current giveaway date and details.

cards.title: Saturday market at 32nd and Barclay
cards.subtitle: East 32nd Street corridor, at Barclay Street
cards.notes: Arrive during the Saturday morning window, check the current vendor offerings, and use the bike racks or nearby transit if that suits your route.
cards.short_summary: A year-round Saturday farmers market at a named Charles Village intersection.
cards.evidence_claim: The 32nd Street Farmers Market operates every Saturday from 7 a.m. to noon at the intersection of 32nd and Barclay Streets.
cards.source_title: About the Market — 32nd Street Farmers Market
cards.access_notes: Open Saturdays, 7 a.m.–12 noon, year-round; vendors and purchases vary.

cards.title: Books and café seating on 33rd
cards.subtitle: East 33rd Street corridor, Charles Village
cards.notes: Use the café-bookstore format for a reading break; check its own site or contact details for current service and event information before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Charles Village café-bookstore at 11 East 33rd Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Bird in Hand is a café-bookstore collaboration in Charles Village at 11 E. 33rd Street.
cards.access_notes: Food, drinks, and books are sold; verify current hours directly with the business.

cards.title: A technicolor diner on West 29th
cards.subtitle: West 29th Street corridor, Remington
cards.notes: Go for a meal and take time to look at the diner’s documented technicolor interior; verify current service details on the restaurant’s site first.
cards.short_summary: A Remington diner documented for its eclectic, technicolor dining setting.
cards.evidence_claim: PaperMoon Diner is located at 227 W. 29th Street and is described by Maryland’s tourism office as an eclectic, technicolor dining experience.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant purchases are required; see the restaurant’s website for current hours.

cards.title: Ten food stalls on West 29th
cards.subtitle: West 29th Street corridor, Remington
cards.notes: Walk through the food hall’s vendor list before choosing a counter; its official site lists ten stalls and current lunch-and-dinner service windows.
cards.short_summary: A Remington food hall with ten vendor stalls.
cards.evidence_claim: R. House is at 301 W. 29th Street and its official site describes ten food stalls with current vendor information.
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are required; the official site lists lunch and dinner hours that vary by day.

cards.title: Retail and cinema on West 40th
cards.subtitle: West 40th Street corridor, Hampden
cards.notes: Use the center directory to pick a shop, service, cinema, or outdoor event-lawn stop, then confirm the individual tenant’s current hours.
cards.short_summary: A mixed-use destination with shops, eateries, services, a cinema, and an event lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rotunda at 711 W. 40th Street has more than 30 shops, eateries, restaurants, services, and a cinema, plus an outdoor event lawn.
cards.access_notes: Individual tenants set their own hours and prices; consult the tenant directory before visiting.

cards.title: A daytime café on Union Avenue
cards.subtitle: Union Avenue corridor, Hampden
cards.notes: Plan this as a daytime food-and-coffee stop: the business lists weekday and weekend service windows and offers dining in or pickup.
cards.short_summary: A café at 1500 Union Avenue with posted daytime service hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Artifact Coffee is at 1500 Union Avenue and lists dining-in and pickup hours of 8 a.m.–3 p.m. weekdays and 8 a.m.–4 p.m. weekends.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for dining in and pickup; listed hours are Mon–Fri 8 a.m.–3 p.m. and Sat–Sun 8 a.m.–4 p.m.

cards.title: Bike service on Falls Road
cards.subtitle: Falls Road corridor, near the Jones Falls
cards.notes: Bring your bicycle and parts for an in-person evaluation; the shop says an initial diagnosis does not require an appointment.
cards.short_summary: A worker-owned bicycle shop offering bike building, maintenance, and repairs.
cards.evidence_claim: Baltimore Bicycle Works is a worker-owned bicycle shop at 1813 Falls Road that provides maintenance and repair services; no appointment is needed for an initial diagnosis.
cards.access_notes: Bring the bicycle or relevant parts for evaluation; repair work and parts may involve charges.
